scope: Basic LAB07 benchmark; not advanced multimodal challenge
test_policy: New test answers from articles disjoint from Day 7 dev and all five old Day 6 test source/article pairs. No Day 7 retrieval/model evaluation run yet; creation and evidence verification are not test-based tuning.
selection_criteria: Dev grounded answer mean (0..2), higher is better
Dev valid citation rate, higher is better (0/0 is not perfect)
Dev correct abstention rate, higher is better
Dev Context Evidence Rate, then Evidence Hit@3, then Hit@1, higher is better
Median end-to-end latency lower, then measured API cost lower; unknown cost cannot win cost tie
If still tied, simpler pipeline; document decision before test
